what: Readings taken over the cable from a Meta Quest 3S while its wearer used Setpiece on the live site (setpiece.jonathansolvesproblems.com) on 17 November 2026, in two sessions. Every set was built by the set designer from sentences the wearer spoke in his own words, except the night chase, which the designer builds by itself as a first visit begins; nothing was replayed. Times are from the session's log (one line each time its state changed, to the second). Frame rates are frames counted over four or five seconds of the session's own animation loop, or the log's own one-minute averages where it says so.
device: Meta Quest 3S, Quest Browser, both hands tracked
caveat: The headset's own screen recorder was running throughout both sessions, to film them. On 16 November it was measured to cost about ten frames a second. No frame rate here was taken with it off, so none of these is quoted in the submission as the app's frame rate.

shoot_coverage.why_fewer: one frame was already on the six-frame board

designer.said: a road crew guiding cars past the part still under construction
five workers building a deck under a clear roof, fenced on the sides and front
part of the fence catches fire and a firefighter hoses it down

frames_per_second_with_the_recorder_runn.where: the deck set on the table in day light (7 pieces), the scene's sky standing behind the set
the same set a few seconds later with that sky switched off
17 pieces with snow, fire, smoke and water all running, the wearer stepping inside during the count
the log's one-minute averages across that 17-piece set
the log's one-minute averages on the lighter sets before it

sessions.what_the_sky_costs: 2.6 frames a second on that set (72.2 with it, 74.8 without)

sessions.change_since: While an effect runs, the monitor is redrawn less often when frames run long (src/viewfinder.ts, EFFECT_LENS_SLOW).

designer.said: workers building an aircraft while civilians watch from a distance
add a ladder over the aircraft with a worker on its roof
it is raining now, add a big umbrella that covers the aircraft

frames_per_second_with_the_recorder_runn.where: the log's one-minute averages: the night chase, the aircraft set, the aircraft set in rain under the umbrella

sessions.boards: After leaving and coming back, the tab for Board 1 brought its six coverage frames up again.
